disaster-response.name: Disaster Response and Crisis Mapping
disaster-response.description: Find matching satellite scenes for time-critical events, whatever the weather.

flood.name: Flood
flood.reason: SAR sees through clouds and works at night, making it the strongest choice for rapid flood extent mapping.
flood.detail: Best for water extent, inundation boundaries, and emergency response after heavy rainfall.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.reason: Multispectral bands reveal burn severity and vegetation stress through spectral change.
wildfire.detail: Best for comparing vegetation health, burn scars, and recently burned surfaces.

earthquake-damage.name: Earthquake Damage
earthquake-damage.reason: SAR backscatter and structural coherence detect collapsed buildings and rubble independent of dust clouds and weather.
earthquake-damage.detail: Best for structural damage assessment, debris detection, and emergency mapping.

environmental-monitoring.name: Environmental Monitoring
environmental-monitoring.description: Read the pulse of forests, water, and protected landscapes from above.

deforestation.name: Deforestation
deforestation.reason: Optical color and radar structure together provide a more reliable view of canopy change and clear-cutting.
deforestation.detail: Best for canopy disturbance, logging roads, and forest boundary change over time.

drought.name: Drought
drought.reason: Visible and near-infrared reflectance directly measures chlorophyll loss, moisture stress, and drying vegetation.
drought.detail: Best for vegetative health indices, moisture monitoring, and agricultural drought tracking.

urban-agricultural.name: Urban and Agricultural Intelligence
urban-agricultural.description: Compare the patterns of fields, infrastructure, and the places where people live.

crop-mapping.name: Crop Mapping
crop-mapping.reason: Combining spectral vegetation indices with radar surface roughness separates crop phenology from soil texture.
crop-mapping.detail: Best for crop classification, phenological stage tracking, and field boundary mapping.
